description: Create, parse, format, and audit Microsoft Excel (.xlsx) workbooks programmatically using openpyxl. Use when generating financial spreadsheets with calculated formulas, applying cell styles and number formats, managing multiple worksheets, building structured tables and charts, handling large files in read-only or write-only mode, or preventing formula injection from untrusted data. Do not use for legacy .xls, Google Sheets API work, pivot-table authoring, or when recalculated values are required without a spreadsheet engine (openpyxl cannot calculate).
